User.title: User
User.description: Represents a single user account in Firebase Authentication.

companyId.description: The ID of the company this user belongs to in the /companies collection. Null for partners.

role.description: The user's role in the system.

passwordChangeRequired.description: If true, the user must change their password on next login.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a single task or reminder for a user.

relatedToName.description: The name of the entity this task is related to (e.g., a partner's name).

assigneeId.description: The UID of the user this task is assigned to.

Partner.title: Partner
Partner.description: Represents a strategic partner, ISA, Investor, Developer, Supplier, Finance Co or Transporter in the system.

status.description: The operational status of the partnership.

invitationStatus.description: The status of their invitation to join the platform.

lastOpenedAt.description: Timestamp of the last email open tracked via pixel.

assigneeId.description: The UID of the staff member allocated to this lead.

CommunicationLog.title: Communication Log
CommunicationLog.description: Records an instance of communication with a partner.

subject.description: The topic of the communication, e.g., 'Company Profile'.

Company.title: Company
Company.description: Represents a member's business entity on the TransConnect platform.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns and manages this company account.

companyName.description: The registered business name of the company.

shopId.description: The ID of the shop owned by this company.

loadBoardId.description: The ID of the load board owned by this company.

vehicleShowroomId.description: The ID of the vehicle showroom owned by this company.

walletBalance.description: Total ledger balance, including pending funds.

pendingBalance.description: Funds from recent sales not yet cleared for withdrawal.

availableBalance.description: Funds cleared and available for withdrawal or purchases.

loyaltyTier.description: The current loyalty status of the member.

activePlans.description: A list of activated Connect plans (e.g., 'loyalty', 'rewards').

isBillable.description: Flag to indicate if the company has an active, billable subscription.

definition.description: Stores individual user profiles. A user can only read/write their own document.
Admin-managed collection of strategic partners, ISAs, suppliers, etc.
Log of communications with a partner.
Subcollection for tasks related to a specific partner.
